summary: The implementation covers much of the saved provider recovery foundation: shared provider-failure classification, structured recovery metadata, fallback policy persistence, provider/model circuit-breaker state and worker suppression, fallback retry attempt creation with lineage, API failure-details exposure, and failure-analysis/resource metrics. Validation passed for focused provider/circuit/API/metrics/runtime tests, ruff, mypy, and the full unit suite; the Alembic Postgres integration test was skipped because AWF_DATABASE_URL is not set. It is not fully conformant because PR-monitor provider recovery can still re-enter the same exhausted provider/model before source-workspace cooldown state is applied.
gaps: PR monitor recovery-loop suppression is incomplete. After an AgentRunError in review-comment, CI-fix, or sync-base recovery, create_provider_recovery_attempt_row records retry/fallback state on the new workspace while the original monitoring_pr workspace remains immediately eligible; with the default circuit threshold, the next monitor loop can invoke the same exhausted provider/model again. Gate the source monitor workspace immediately via cooldown state, circuit state, or equivalent suppression, and cover review-comment, CI-fix, and sync-base paths.

The saved PR-monitor provider recovery regression tests are missing. Existing runtime tests pass but do not assert provider recovery events/operations, fallback attempt preparation, or next-loop suppression for provider capacity/usage-limit failures during monitor recovery.

Postgres Alembic migration validation did not execute in this workspace because tests/integration/test_alembic_postgres.py skipped without AWF_DATABASE_URL. Run that validation against a configured Postgres URL or document the environment limitation in the PR.
